reserveReview.rationale: Blast states that bridged stablecoins mint USDB, that USDB yield comes from MakerDAO's on-chain T-Bill protocol, and that users receive DAI when bridging back to Ethereum. The documented backing path therefore remains a full DAI/Maker yield-manager dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Blast documented USDB bridge and yield-manager design
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Blast does not publish a current reserve report or a bounded liquidation horizon for the MakerDAO yield-manager position.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The official documentation identifies the protocol path but does not publish asset-segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, provider-share, or current reserve-account details. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because bridged stablecoin backing is explicitly deployed into an external yield protocol.
